org.tmt.aps.peas.config.business

Class IterationEntityCache

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.tmt.aps.peas.config.business.IterationEntityCache

  • @Named
public class IterationEntityCache
extends Object
    EJB Singleton cache for all iteration entities. On initialization, this EJB calls IterationMgmt#findIterationListConfigOptions(Long) decodes the option lists for each procedure type and composes the IterationValueList for each option value. Provides methods for querying options. This EJB is initialized on startup.

    smichaels

      • decodeList

        public IterationValueList decodeList(String encodedList,
                            List<String> classNames)
        Decodes a string representation of an IterationList to a List of IterationValues. Values are encoded as x1, y1,..., x2, y2,...,... where x1 is the key value for the iterable entity of class x, and y1 is the key value for the iterable entity class y1.
        Parameters:
        encodedList - the string encoded list
        className - list of class names in the same order as in each iteration value
        Returns:
        a List of decoded IterationValues
